description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of data sources in the AttrEval-Simulation, displaying a total of six distinct categories. Rather than utilizing a separate legend or placing percentage labels directly inside the slices, the chart employs external text labels paired with percentages, which are connected to their respective slices via thin grey callout lines. Proceeding clockwise from the top right, the segments include ENTITYQUEST in blue at 26.0%, HOTPOTQA in red at 24.2%, POPQA in yellow at 21.6%, TREC in green at 1.9%, TRIVIAQA in orange at 22.7%, and WEBQUESTIO in teal at 3.6%. The chart does not present the segments in a strictly ascending or descending order based on size, and none of the slices are visually emphasized through exploding, bolding, or offsetting.
